d2c_orders.sql: SELECT sum(CASE WHEN coalesce(d2c_orders.is_deleted, FALSE) = FALSE THEN d2c_orders.line_item_qty END) AS units_sold, sum(CASE WHEN coalesce(d2c_orders.is_deleted, FALSE) = FALSE THEN d2c_orders.line_item_qty * d2c_orders.line_item_price END) AS gross_revenue_inr, sum(CASE WHEN coalesce(d2c_orders.is_deleted, FALSE) = FALSE THEN d2c_orders.shipping_amount END) AS shipping_inr, sum(CASE WHEN coalesce(d2c_orders.is_deleted, FALSE) = FALSE THEN d2c_orders.line_item_qty * d2c_orders.line_item_price + d2c_orders.shipping_amount END) AS net_after_fees_inr, sum(CASE WHEN coalesce(d2c_orders.is_deleted, FALSE) = FALSE THEN d2c_orders.line_total END) AS revenue_inr FROM sahil-devx.dev_dna_silver.d2c_orders AS d2c_orders LIMIT 1000

platform_orders.sql: SELECT sum(CASE WHEN coalesce(platform_orders.is_deleted, FALSE) = FALSE THEN platform_orders.units END) AS units_sold, sum(CASE WHEN coalesce(platform_orders.is_deleted, FALSE) = FALSE THEN platform_orders.units * platform_orders.unit_price END) AS gross_revenue_inr, sum(CASE WHEN coalesce(platform_orders.is_deleted, FALSE) = FALSE THEN platform_orders.promo_discount END) AS discount_inr, sum(CASE WHEN coalesce(platform_orders.is_deleted, FALSE) = FALSE THEN platform_orders.marketplace_fee END) AS marketplace_fee_inr, sum(CASE WHEN coalesce(platform_orders.is_deleted, FALSE) = FALSE THEN platform_orders.units * platform_orders.unit_price - platform_orders.promo_discount - platform_orders.marketplace_fee END) AS net_after_fees_inr, sum(CASE WHEN coalesce(platform_orders.is_deleted, FALSE) = FALSE THEN platform_orders.units * platform_orders.unit_price - platform_orders.promo_discount END) AS revenue_inr FROM sahil-devx.dev_dna_silver.platform_orders AS platform_orders LIMIT 1000

qcomm_orders.sql: SELECT sum(CASE WHEN coalesce(qcomm_orders.is_deleted, FALSE) = FALSE THEN qcomm_orders.qty END) AS units_sold, sum(CASE WHEN coalesce(qcomm_orders.is_deleted, FALSE) = FALSE THEN qcomm_orders.qty * qcomm_orders.mrp END) AS gross_revenue_inr, sum(CASE WHEN coalesce(qcomm_orders.is_deleted, FALSE) = FALSE THEN qcomm_orders.total_discount END) AS discount_inr, sum(CASE WHEN coalesce(qcomm_orders.is_deleted, FALSE) = FALSE THEN qcomm_orders.delivery_fee END) AS delivery_fee_inr, sum(CASE WHEN coalesce(qcomm_orders.is_deleted, FALSE) = FALSE THEN qcomm_orders.qty * qcomm_orders.mrp - qcomm_orders.total_discount - qcomm_orders.delivery_fee END) AS net_after_fees_inr, sum(CASE WHEN coalesce(qcomm_orders.is_deleted, FALSE) = FALSE THEN qcomm_orders.qty * qcomm_orders.selling_price END) AS revenue_inr FROM sahil-devx.dev_dna_silver.qcomm_orders AS qcomm_orders LIMIT 1000

offline_orders.sql: SELECT sum(CASE WHEN coalesce(offline_orders.is_deleted, FALSE) = FALSE THEN offline_orders.qty END) AS units_sold, sum(CASE WHEN coalesce(offline_orders.is_deleted, FALSE) = FALSE THEN offline_orders.qty * offline_orders.mrp END) AS gross_revenue_inr, sum(CASE WHEN coalesce(offline_orders.is_deleted, FALSE) = FALSE THEN offline_orders.qty * offline_orders.mrp - offline_orders.net_amount END) AS discount_inr, sum(CASE WHEN coalesce(offline_orders.is_deleted, FALSE) = FALSE THEN offline_orders.net_amount END) AS net_after_fees_inr, sum(CASE WHEN coalesce(offline_orders.is_deleted, FALSE) = FALSE THEN offline_orders.net_amount END) AS revenue_inr FROM sahil-devx.dev_dna_silver.offline_orders AS offline_orders LIMIT 1000

international_orders.sql: SELECT sum(CASE WHEN coalesce(international_orders.is_deleted, FALSE) = FALSE THEN international_orders.qty END) AS units_sold, sum(CASE WHEN coalesce(international_orders.is_deleted, FALSE) = FALSE THEN international_orders.qty * international_orders.unit_price_usd * 83 END) AS gross_revenue_inr, sum(CASE WHEN coalesce(international_orders.is_deleted, FALSE) = FALSE THEN international_orders.qty * international_orders.unit_price_usd END) AS gross_revenue_usd, sum(CASE WHEN coalesce(international_orders.is_deleted, FALSE) = FALSE THEN (international_orders.qty * international_orders.unit_price_usd - international_orders.customs_duty_usd) * 83 END) AS net_after_fees_inr, sum(CASE WHEN coalesce(international_orders.is_deleted, FALSE) = FALSE THEN international_orders.qty * international_orders.unit_price_usd * 83 END) AS revenue_inr FROM sahil-devx.dev_dna_silver.international_orders AS international_orders LIMIT 1000

cafe_sales.sql: SELECT sum(CASE WHEN coalesce(cafe_sales.is_deleted, FALSE) = FALSE THEN cafe_sales.qty END) AS units_sold, sum(CASE WHEN coalesce(cafe_sales.is_deleted, FALSE) = FALSE THEN cafe_sales.amount END) AS net_after_fees_inr, sum(CASE WHEN coalesce(cafe_sales.is_deleted, FALSE) = FALSE THEN cafe_sales.amount END) AS revenue_inr FROM sahil-devx.dev_dna_silver.cafe_sales AS cafe_sales LIMIT 1000

returns.sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN returns.rn = 1 AND coalesce(returns.is_deleted, FALSE) = FALSE THEN returns.return_id END) AS return_count, sum(CASE WHEN returns.rn = 1 AND coalesce(returns.is_deleted, FALSE) = FALSE THEN returns.refund_amount END) AS refund_amount_inr FROM sahil-devx.dev_dna_silver.returns AS returns LIMIT 1000

sales_by_channel.sql:
WITH sales AS (
select hash_key as sales_line_key, 'D2C' as channel_code, order_date_key, product_id,
       cast(null as string) as order_status, line_item_qty as quantity,
       line_item_qty * line_item_price as gross_amount_inr,
       cast(0 as numeric) as discount_amount_inr,
       shipping_amount as shipping_amount_inr,
       line_item_qty * line_item_price + shipping_amount as net_amount_inr,
       line_total as revenue_inr
from `sahil-devx.dev_dna_silver.d2c_orders` where coalesce(is_deleted, false) = false
union all
select hash_key, 'PLATFORM', order_date_key, product_id, fulfillment_status, units,
       units * unit_price, promo_discount, cast(0 as numeric),
       units * unit_price - promo_discount - marketplace_fee,
       units * unit_price - promo_discount
from `sahil-devx.dev_dna_silver.platform_orders` where coalesce(is_deleted, false) = false
union all
select hash_key, 'QCOMM', order_date_key, product_id, order_status, qty,
       qty * mrp, total_discount, delivery_fee,
       qty * mrp - total_discount - delivery_fee,
       qty * selling_price
from `sahil-devx.dev_dna_silver.qcomm_orders` where coalesce(is_deleted, false) = false
union all
select hash_key, 'OFFLINE', order_date_key, product_id, cast(null as string), qty,
       qty * mrp, qty * mrp - net_amount, cast(0 as numeric), net_amount, net_amount
from `sahil-devx.dev_dna_silver.offline_orders` where coalesce(is_deleted, false) = false
union all
select hash_key, 'INTERNATIONAL', order_date_key, product_id, shipment_status, qty,
       qty * unit_price_usd * 83, cast(0 as numeric), shipping_cost_usd * 83,
       (qty * unit_price_usd - customs_duty_usd) * 83,
       qty * unit_price_usd * 83
from `sahil-devx.dev_dna_silver.international_orders` where coalesce(is_deleted, false) = false
union all
select hash_key, 'CAFE', order_date_key, product_id, cast(null as string), qty,
       amount, cast(0 as numeric), cast(0 as numeric), amount, amount
from `sahil-devx.dev_dna_silver.cafe_sales` where coalesce(is_deleted, false) = false
)
SELECT sales.channel_code AS channel_code, sum(sales.revenue_inr) AS revenue_inr, sum(sales.net_amount_inr) AS net_after_fees_inr, sum(sales.gross_amount_inr) AS gross_revenue_inr, sum(sales.discount_amount_inr) AS discount_inr, sum(sales.quantity) AS units_sold, count(sales.sales_line_key) AS sales_lines FROM sales GROUP BY channel_code ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 1000
